lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information for Kazakhstan. The dataset contains approximately 2.8 million mapped buildings with an average data age of 4 years, representing approximately 33% of estimated total building stock based on AI-mapping estimates. Data are provided in multiple geospatial formats (SHP, KML, GeoJSON, Geopackage) for integration into disaster risk assessment workflows.
